description: Dutch public-sector reference architectures: NORA (national, binding via comply-or-explain) and GEMMA/Common Ground (municipalities). For architects working on or with Dutch government digital services.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::01 NORA Basics & Governance
notes.front: What does NORA stand for?
notes.back: Nederlandse Overheid Referentie Architectuur — the Dutch Government Reference Architecture.
notes.extra: The national afsprakenstelsel for designing public digital services. Has no version numbers since 2011; maintained incrementally on noraonline.nl.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::01 NORA Basics & Governance
notes.text: NORA is owned by the Ministry {{c1::BZK}} (Interior), maintained by {{c2::ICTU}}, and its content authority is the {{c3::NORA Gebruikersraad}} (Users' Council).
notes.extra: The Gebruikersraad approves binding changes via a Request for Change (RFC).

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::01 NORA Basics & Governance
notes.front: What makes NORA's architecture agreements binding?
notes.back: Pas toe of leg uit (comply or explain): apply each binding agreement, or justify why you deviate.
notes.analogy: Like a building code with a variance procedure: you may deviate, but only on the record and with reasons.
notes.extra: Applies at (re)design of digital services across all government layers.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::01 NORA Basics & Governance
notes.front: Why does NORA use pas toe of leg uit (comply or explain) instead of a flat mandate?
notes.back: It keeps agreements binding by default while letting an organisation with a legitimate reason deviate, and the explanation makes deviations visible and accountable.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::01 NORA Basics & Governance
notes.front: Which organisations fall under NORA's scope?
notes.back: The whole public sector: central government, provinces, municipalities, water authorities (waterschappen) and ZBOs, when (re)designing digital services.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::01 NORA Basics & Governance
notes.front: What is the NORA Familie?
notes.back: Derived sector/government-layer reference architectures that align to NORA and share its language and Vijflaagsmodel.
notes.analogy: NORA is the national constitution; family members are provincial laws that must stay consistent with it.
notes.extra: Example: GEMMA (municipalities, managed by VNG); ROSA (education).

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::01 NORA Basics & Governance
notes.front: In NORA, what is a Project Start Architectuur (PSA)?
notes.back: A project-level document showing, at project start, how the project complies with NORA's binding agreements.
notes.extra: Historically mandatory for large government ICT projects (often cited: above €20 million).

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::01 NORA Basics & Governance
notes.front: How does NORA tie into Forum Standaardisatie?
notes.back: Government must apply the open standards on Forum Standaardisatie's 'pas toe of leg uit' list, or explain deviations in its annual report.
notes.extra: Linked to NAP08 (Standaardiseer waar mogelijk); mandatory in procurement above set thresholds.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::02 NORA Binding Agreements
notes.text:
NORA's Bindende Architectuurafspraken, generic → specific:
1. {{c1::Kernwaarden van Dienstverlening}}
2. {{c2::Kwaliteitsdoelen}}
3. {{c3::Architectuurprincipes}} (NAP01–17)
4. {{c4::Implicaties van Architectuurprincipes}}
notes.analogy: A funnel from values to work orders: why we care → what we want → how we design → what you concretely do.
notes.extra: These four levels form the binding content core of NORA.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::02 NORA Binding Agreements
notes.front: Since 1 January 2023, what replaced NORA's old core of 10 Basisprincipes + 40 Afgeleide Principes?
notes.back: The four-level Bindende Architectuurafspraken (Kernwaarden → Kwaliteitsdoelen → Architectuurprincipes → Implicaties).
notes.extra: Pitfall: many third-party sites still teach the deprecated 10/40 model.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::02 NORA Binding Agreements
notes.front: In the 2023 NORA restructure, where did the old Basisprincipes and Afgeleide Principes go?
notes.back:
Basisprincipes → recognisable in the Kwaliteitsdoelen.
Afgeleide Principes → mostly the new Architectuurprincipes (or their implications).

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::02 NORA Binding Agreements
notes.front: In NORA, what are the Kernwaarden van Dienstverlening?
notes.back: The top, most generic level: fundamental convictions rooted in societal values that all government service delivery must satisfy.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::02 NORA Binding Agreements
notes.front: List NORA's five Kernwaarden of government service delivery, and what each demands.
notes.back:
Service delivery must be:
  • Vertrouwen: trustworthy
  • Veilig: safe
  • Toekomstgericht: future-oriented
  • Doeltreffend: effective
  • Doelmatig: efficient
notes.extra: Contrast: doeltreffend = achieves the goal; doelmatig = achieves it without waste.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::02 NORA Binding Agreements
notes.front: Which NORA level answers the WHAT (het wat) of service delivery from the citizen's/business's perspective?
notes.back: The Kwaliteitsdoelen (quality goals), the 2nd level.
notes.extra: About 20 of them, derived from the Kernwaarden and grounded in law/policy. Unlike principles, they don't use the stelling/rationale/implicaties format.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::02 NORA Binding Agreements
notes.front: Which NORA level answers the HOW (het hoe) — how quality goals are realised in service design?
notes.back: The Architectuurprincipes (NAP01–NAP17), the 3rd level.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::02 NORA Binding Agreements
notes.front: What is the format of a NORA Architectuurprincipe?
notes.back: Stelling (statement) — Rationale — Implicaties.
notes.extra: Borrowed from the TOGAF principle format.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::02 NORA Binding Agreements
notes.front: In NORA, what are Implicaties van Architectuurprincipes?
notes.back: The 4th, most specific level: concrete consequences/requirements that a principle imposes on practice.
notes.extra: Not 1-to-1: one implication can support several principles.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: NORA principle Verplaats je in de gebruiker — what does it ask?
notes.back: Design from the user's perspective and needs.
notes.extra: Code: NAP01.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: NORA principle Geef inzicht in de dienst — what does it ask?
notes.back: Make how the service works, and how a case is progressing, transparent to the user.
notes.extra: Code: NAP02.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: NORA principle Kanaal-onafhankelijk resultaat — what does it ask?
notes.back: Same outcome whichever channel (web, phone, desk) the user picks.
notes.analogy: Like a bank where the balance is the same in the app, at the ATM and at the counter.
notes.extra: Code: NAP03.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: A benefit application gets approved online but the same case by phone gets rejected. Which NORA principle is broken?
notes.back: Kanaal-onafhankelijk resultaat: the outcome must not depend on the channel chosen.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: NORA principle Bundel diensten — what does it ask?
notes.back: Offer related services together so users aren't sent from desk to desk.
notes.extra: Code: NAP04.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: NORA principle Bied de dienst proactief aan — what does it ask?
notes.back: Anticipate entitlements and needs instead of waiting for an application.
notes.extra: Code: NAP05.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: NORA principle Hergebruik diensten — what does it ask?
notes.back: Reuse existing services/building blocks instead of rebuilding.
notes.extra: Code: NAP06.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: NORA principle Ontkoppel diensten — what does it ask?
notes.back: Build modular, loosely coupled services that can change independently.
notes.extra: Code: NAP07.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: NORA principle Standaardiseer waar mogelijk — what does it ask?
notes.back: Use (open) standards wherever possible.
notes.extra: Code: NAP08.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: NORA principle Beschrijf de dienst nauwkeurig — what does it ask?
notes.back: Document services precisely, including their information objects.
notes.extra: Code: NAP09.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: NORA principle Neem gegevens als fundament — what does it ask?
notes.back: Treat data and data management as an explicit architecture concern.
notes.extra: Code: NAP10.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: NORA principle Doelbinding — what does it ask?
notes.back: Use data only for the purpose it was collected for (purpose limitation, AVG/GDPR).
notes.analogy: Data collected for a parking permit is not a free sample for the tax office.
notes.extra: Code: NAP11.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: NORA principle Informeer bij de bron — what does it ask?
notes.back: Use authentic source registrations; query data at the source rather than copying it.
notes.analogy: Ask the registry office for the birth date every time instead of keeping your own photocopy that silently goes stale.
notes.extra: Code: NAP12.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: A service asks citizens to retype their address, which government already holds. Which NORA principle is violated, and what should happen instead?
notes.back: Informeer bij de bron: query the authentic source registration instead of asking again or copying data.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: NORA principle Risico-oriëntatie — what does it ask?
notes.back: Continuously identify and manage the service's risks.
notes.extra: Code: NAP13.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: NORA principle Verifieer altijd — what does it ask?
notes.back: Never assume trust; always verify identity and authorisation.
notes.analogy: Zero trust: like a building where every door checks your badge, not just the front entrance.
notes.extra: Code: NAP14.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: NORA principle Maak diensten schaalbaar — what does it ask?
notes.back: Design services to cope with changing or growing demand.
notes.extra: Code: NAP15.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: NORA principle Voorkom onnodige complexiteit — what does it ask?
notes.back: Keep designs as simple as the problem allows.
notes.extra: Code: NAP16.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::03 NORA Architecture Principles (NAP)
notes.front: NORA principle Stuur cyclisch op kwaliteit — what does it ask?
notes.back: Steer on quality through continuous (PDCA-style) feedback and improvement.
notes.extra: Code: NAP17.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::04 Vijflaagsmodel
notes.front: What is the NORA Vijflaagsmodel for?
notes.back: Classifying architecture elements into five layers, giving architects a shared language to look at a problem from five viewpoints.
notes.extra: Underpins many NORA-family architectures; also useful when talking to non-architects.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::04 Vijflaagsmodel
notes.analogy: Read it as a chain of justification: law → organisation → meaning of data → software → wires.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::04 Vijflaagsmodel
notes.front: NORA Vijflaagsmodel — what belongs in the Grondslagenlaag?
notes.back: Laws, regulations and policy frameworks that bind the service.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::04 Vijflaagsmodel
notes.front: NORA Vijflaagsmodel — what belongs in the Organisatorische laag?
notes.back: People, roles, responsibilities, processes and agreements through which the service is delivered.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::04 Vijflaagsmodel
notes.front: NORA Vijflaagsmodel — what belongs in the Informatielaag?
notes.back: The information objects of the service: the meaning given to data in context.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::04 Vijflaagsmodel
notes.front: NORA Vijflaagsmodel — what belongs in the Applicatielaag?
notes.back: Applications and shared provisions (voorzieningen, building blocks) that support the service.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::04 Vijflaagsmodel
notes.front: NORA Vijflaagsmodel — what belongs in the IT-Infrastructuurlaag?
notes.back: Networks and infrastructure under the service (e.g. internet, Diginetwerk).

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::04 Vijflaagsmodel
notes.front: A new law changes who is eligible for a service. In the NORA Vijflaagsmodel, which layer changes first and how does the change ripple down?
notes.back: Grondslagenlaag (the law) first, then the Organisatorische laag (processes/roles), Informatielaag (information objects), Applicatielaag (systems), and finally infrastructure only if needed.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::04 Vijflaagsmodel
notes.front: NORA Vijflaagsmodel vs Common Ground vijflaagsmodel: key difference?
notes.back: NORA's layers are viewpoints for classifying any architecture element (Grondslagen → IT-infra). Common Ground's layers are a technical decoupling stack (Interactie → Gegevensbronnen) that separates process logic from data.
notes.extra: Both have five layers; GEMMA's Basisarchitectuur has four (Strategie en motivatie, Bedrijfs-, Informatie-, Technische architectuur).

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::05 GEMMA Basics & Principles
notes.front: What does GEMMA stand for?
notes.back: GEMeentelijke Model Architectuur — the reference architecture for all Dutch municipalities.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::05 GEMMA Basics & Principles
notes.front: Which organisation maintains GEMMA?
notes.back: The VNG (Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten); published on GEMMA Online.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::05 GEMMA Basics & Principles
notes.front: Order from broadest to most specific: NORA, EIRA, GEMMA.
notes.back: EIRA (European governments) → NORA (Dutch government) → GEMMA (Dutch municipalities).
notes.analogy: Like nested building codes: EU directive → national code → municipal bylaw.
notes.extra: GEMMA builds on NORA as a member of the NORA Familie.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::05 GEMMA Basics & Principles
notes.front: What is GEMMA's main purpose?
notes.back: Help municipalities steer ICT coherently: develop, buy and implement under architecture so solutions work together.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::05 GEMMA Basics & Principles
notes.text: The GEMMA glossary defines a referentiearchitectuur as a {{c1::template solution (sjabloonoplossing)}} for the architecture of a particular domain.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::05 GEMMA Basics & Principles
notes.front: Which modelling language does GEMMA use?
notes.back: ArchiMate.
notes.extra: Elements are ordered by function and/or architecture layer.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::05 GEMMA Basics & Principles
notes.front: Why must a municipality translate GEMMA models instead of adopting them verbatim?
notes.back: Municipalities differ in organisation and vision; a reference model is a template, not a blueprint of any one municipality.
notes.analogy: A reference architecture is a dress pattern, not a finished dress: you still cut it to your size.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::05 GEMMA Basics & Principles
notes.front: What are architectuurprincipes according to GEMMA?
notes.back: Directive, qualitative statements of intent that the architecture must meet; they translate goals and policy into guidance for execution.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::05 GEMMA Basics & Principles
notes.front: Are GEMMA architecture principles binding like NORA's?
notes.back: No. NORA binds via pas toe of leg uit; GEMMA principles are best practices that each municipality applies as it sees fit. Support (draagvlak) is essential.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::05 GEMMA Basics & Principles
notes.front: What did the 2024/2025 renewal of GEMMA principles produce?
notes.back: One set of GEMMA principles aligned with Common Ground; the separate Common Ground principles became obsolete.
notes.extra: Before: GEMMA adopted all NORA principles plus three GEMMA-specific ones.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::05 GEMMA Basics & Principles
notes.text: GEMMA Gegevenslandschap principles include: We werken met {{c1::componenten}}; We leggen gegevens {{c2::eenmalig vast en vragen op bij de bron}}; We {{c3::standaardiseren}} maximaal; We zorgen dat {{c4::informatiebeveiliging en privacy}} op orde zijn.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::05 GEMMA Basics & Principles
notes.text: The Gegevenslandschap principles that most put citizens' interests first: We zijn {{c1::transparant}} waar mogelijk; We faciliteren {{c2::regie op gegevens}} (control over one's own data).

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::05 GEMMA Basics & Principles
notes.front: Principles in the Dutch municipal context are layered (GEMeentelijke Model Architectuur (GEMMA) → Gegevenslandschap → Common Ground). What does a higher layer do to the one below it?
notes.back: It frames and constrains it; the lower layer's principles make the higher ones more concrete.
notes.extra: Example: 'We werken met componenten' was concretised by 'We ontwikkelen en gebruiken NLX als gateway'.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::06 GEMMA Models & Components
notes.text: The four layers of the GEMMA Basisarchitectuur: {{c1::Strategie en motivatie}}, {{c2::Bedrijfsarchitectuur}}, {{c3::Informatiearchitectuur}}, {{c4::Technische architectuur}}.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::06 GEMMA Models & Components
notes.front: In GEMMA, what does the bedrijfsarchitectuur describe?
notes.back: What the municipality does, which units do it, and how (processes). It is the basis for the information architecture.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::06 GEMMA Models & Components
notes.front: In GEMMA, what is the procesarchitectuur?
notes.back: The part of the business architecture with principles and agreements for setting up business processes.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::06 GEMMA Models & Components
notes.front: In the GEMMA procesarchitectuur, what is a ketenpartner?
notes.back: A role (not an organisation) for process work done partly outside the municipality, e.g. the passport producer or a WMO assessment body.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::06 GEMMA Models & Components
notes.front: How does GEMMA define a bedrijfsfunctie?
notes.back: A grouping of activities that need comparable resources, knowledge or competences.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::06 GEMMA Models & Components
notes.front: What is a GEMMA referentiecomponent?
notes.back: A modular, independently replaceable software building block that groups related functionality behind well-defined interfaces.
notes.analogy: A standard-size LEGO brick: any supplier's brick that fits the studs can replace another.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::06 GEMMA Models & Components
notes.front: A municipality wants to switch its case-management (zaaksysteem) supplier. Which referentiecomponent property makes this feasible?
notes.back: Components are independently replaceable and hide functionality behind well-defined interfaces, so a conforming replacement slots in without redesigning the rest.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::06 GEMMA Models & Components
notes.extra: Domain views often omit the applicatieservices for readability.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::06 GEMMA Models & Components
notes.front: Per GEMMA, give an example of domain-specific vs generic municipal software.
notes.back:
Specific: a vergunningensysteem (permits).
Generic: a zaaksysteem (case management) or a service bus.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::06 GEMMA Models & Components
notes.front: Is the GEMMA applicatieservice-model normative?
notes.back: It is richtinggevend (directive): as a reference architecture it guides, but doesn't dictate, municipal information management.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::06 GEMMA Models & Components
notes.front: What does each GEMMA domeinarchitectuur work out?
notes.back: A bedrijfsfunctiemodel and an applicatieservice-model for that domain (e.g. Sociaal domein).

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::06 GEMMA Models & Components
notes.front: GEMMA definition: informatievoorziening
notes.back: The whole of people, resources and measures aimed at the organisation's information needs.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::06 GEMMA Models & Components
notes.front: GEMMA: informatie vs gegeven?
notes.back:
Gegeven: a recorded observation about a property of an object.
Informatie: the meaning people give to data in a context.
notes.analogy: '38.5' is a gegeven; 'the child has a fever' is informatie.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::07 Common Ground
notes.front: What does Common Ground contribute, what does GEMMA contribute, and how do they fit together?
notes.back: Common Ground is the municipalities' informatiekundige visie (the 'why' and target shape); GEMMA works out the generic functions to realise it (and since 2025 carries its principles).

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::07 Common Ground
notes.front: What is Common Ground's core idea about data?
notes.back: Decouple data from processes and applications; query data at the source instead of copying and storing it repeatedly.
notes.analogy: Streaming instead of downloading: everyone watches the same master copy, so nobody's copy goes stale.
notes.extra: Same idea as NORA's 'Informeer bij de bron'.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::07 Common Ground
notes.front: What goes wrong if each municipal application copies data instead of querying the source?
notes.back: Copies go stale and diverge (several 'truths'), corrections don't propagate, and personal data spreads to more places, raising privacy and security risk.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::07 Common Ground
notes.text: The renewed Common Ground vijflaagsmodel, top → bottom: {{c1::Interactie}}, {{c2::Procesinrichting}}, {{c3::Connectiviteit}}, {{c4::Diensten}}, {{c5::Gegevensbronnen}}.
notes.extra: Original model: Interactie, Proces, Integratie, Services, Data.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::07 Common Ground
notes.front: Common Ground: what sits in the top two layers (Interactie, Procesinrichting)?
notes.back: Interaction with citizens, businesses and staff, and execution of municipal processes.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::07 Common Ground
notes.front: Common Ground: what does the middle layer Connectiviteit do?
notes.back: Handles communication between the functions in the upper and lower layers.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::07 Common Ground
notes.front: Common Ground: what do the bottom layers (Diensten, Gegevensbronnen) provide?
notes.back: Responsible, standardised storage of data and its disclosure (ontsluiting) via services.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::07 Common Ground
notes.front: Why does the Common Ground model group functions per layer?
notes.back: To separate process execution from recording/providing data in source registrations, giving a more modular information landscape.
notes.analogy: Like separating the kitchen (processes) from the pantry (data): many kitchens can draw from one well-stocked pantry.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::07 Common Ground
notes.front: Common Ground: what is expected of a dienstenafnemer (service consumer)?
notes.back: Slim user interfaces that use data from source registrations as much as possible.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::07 Common Ground
notes.front: Why does Common Ground insist on standardised Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) between service providers and consumers?
notes.back: So a consumer application can be replaced, or a source changed, without breaking the other side: that is what decouples process logic from data.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::07 Common Ground
notes.front: Common Ground: what is expected of a dienstenaanbieder (service provider)?
notes.back: Standardised APIs through which consumers access source data.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::08 GEMMA Standards & Ecosystem
notes.front: Which tool maps supplier software onto GEMMA reference components and standards?
notes.back: The GEMMA Softwarecatalogus.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::08 GEMMA Standards & Ecosystem
notes.front: What is GIBIT and how does it use GEMMA?
notes.back: Gemeentelijke Inkoop bij IT: municipal IT procurement terms; GEMMA is the frame for its ICT quality norms.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::08 GEMMA Standards & Ecosystem
notes.front: What is GEMMA Verwerkingenlogging?
notes.back: Information model + APIs for logging each processing of personal data, so municipalities can meet the AVG (GDPR) accountability duty.
notes.extra: Contrast: Verwerkingsactiviteiten = the register of types of processing; Verwerkingenlogging = the log of individual processings.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::08 GEMMA Standards & Ecosystem
notes.front: What is GEMMA Verwerkingsactiviteiten?
notes.back: Information model + APIs for the AVG verwerkingsregister (register of processing activities): legal basis, purpose, categories of personal data.
notes.analogy: The register is the menu of what the kitchen may cook; Verwerkingenlogging is the till receipt of every dish actually served.

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::08 GEMMA Standards & Ecosystem
notes.front: Contrast GEMMA Verwerkingenlogging with Verwerkingsactiviteiten.
notes.back:
Verwerkingenlogging: a record of each actual processing of personal data (who, when, what).
Verwerkingsactiviteiten: the register of planned processing activities (purpose, legal basis, data categories).

notes.deck: NORA & GEMMA (Dutch Government Architecture)::08 GEMMA Standards & Ecosystem
notes.front: What is Zaakgericht Werken (ZGW) in GEMMA?
notes.back: Case-oriented working: a GEMMA theme with VNG API standards (ZGW APIs) for case handling.
